11.t: Working with data: the knee-jerk reflex
q: State the reflex time for student 2 when rested.
Calculate the means for the tired students.
Explain why the reflex is so fast compared with a reaction time of about 250 ms.
A reflex arc goes through the spinal cord with very few synapses; it does not need the brain to decide.
A student concludes that tiredness slows reflexes. Evaluate this.
The difference (2-3 ms) is very small and only 3 students were tested; it could be chance. A larger sample with repeats is needed.
